THE FOUNDATIONAL ESSAY

Power Must Serve Life

We can build a civilisation in which growing power gives people greater freedom to live, understand, create, and care. I intend to help make it real.

The full arc of a kenotic programme for science, computing, and human flourishing. From following Jesus and an account of power shaped by service, through disciplined inquiry and accountable construction, into capabilities people can keep.

SOURCERER / A PERSONAL ESSAY

Make the magic answerable.
